info.name: Renown Perks
info.description: Faction renown perks from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy). Add earned perks to your character from the Equipment tab (category: Renown Perks).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: The perks listed here apply to all the factions of Azeroth:
Friendly (Renown 3+). Other members of the faction are Friendly to you by default.
Honored (Renown 10+). You can purchase equipment found in the Player’s Handbook, as well as Common or Uncommon magic items, from merchants of the faction at a 10% discount.
Revered (Renown 25+). Your discount increases to 15% and extends to Rare magic items.
Exalted (Renown 50+). Your discount increases to 25% and extends to Very Rare magic items.
Certain mounts and magic items are available only from merchants associated with a particular faction and might require a minimum Renown Score with that faction to purchase.

Starting Renown. Most characters created using the World of Warcraft species have a starting Renown Score of 3 with one of the subfactions associated with either the Alliance or the Horde. A few species and class options give starting Renown Scores with other factions.

description.p: Several renown perks give you the opportunity to work with a trainer to learn a language or gain a proficiency. The days required needn’t be consecutive, but you must spend 8 consecutive hours with the trainer for a day to count. You can gain only one tool proficiency from each renown perk.

description.p: If your species gives you a starting Renown Score with an Alliance or Horde subfaction, gaining renown with different subfactions of the same faction also increases your Renown Score with your starting faction:
Friendly. The first time your Renown Score with each other subfaction reaches 3, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 1.
Honored. The first time your Renown Score with each other subfaction reaches 10, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 2.
Revered. The first time your Renown Score with each other subfaction reaches 25, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 3.
Exalted. The first time your Renown Score with each other subfaction reaches 50, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 5.
Alliance subfactions: Darnassus (night elves), Exodar (draenei), Gilneas (worgen), Gnomeregan (gnomes), Ironforge (dwarves), Obsidian Warders (dracthyr), Stormwind (humans), Tushui (pandaren).

Horde subfactions: Bilgewater Cartel (goblins), Dark Talons (dracthyr), Darkspear Tribe (trolls), Huojin (pandaren), Orgrimmar (orcs and vulpera), Silvermoon City (blood elves), Thunder Bluff (tauren), Undercity (Forsaken).

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Darnassus, the Exodar, Gilneas, Gnomeregan, Ironforge, and Stormwind

You have the title Ambassador of the Alliance. You can gain an audience with the leader of any Alliance subfaction at any time, and you can summon the leaders of the Alliance forces into council, given 1 week’s notice. For a worthy cause, any or all of these leaders will commit troops to aid you, at the DM’s discretion. You can also call on Alleria Windrunner, Anduin Wrynn, or Jaina Proudmoore (all described in chapter 7) to assist you on one adventure.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Bilgewater Cartel

You can request a Clockwerk Charm from the leaders of the Bilgewater Cartel before you undertake a quest on their behalf. This Charm allows you to cast the Summon Construct spell (Metal only), which lasts for 1 hour and doesn’t require Concentration. The Construct Spirit appears as a mechanical goblin. When it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, the summoned spirit explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere of fire. Creatures in the Sphere make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The Charm lasts until you use it once or you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request this Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Bilgewater Cartel increases.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Dark Talons

You can request a Charm from the leaders of the Dark Talons before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive the Charm of Terror, and it lasts until you use it three times or you complete or abandon the quest. You can take a Magic action to release a wave of terror. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can’t make Opportunity Attacks. For its action, it can take only the Dash action or an action to try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you request this Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Dark Talons increases.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Darkspear Tribe

During a Short Rest, you can make offerings to the loa revered by trolls to gain a Charm. When you finish the rest, make a DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check. On a successful check, you gain a Charm that allows you to gain the benefit of one of the following Potions as a Bonus Action (choose when you gain the Charm): Potion of Animal Friendship, Potion of Climbing, Potion of Comprehension, Potion of Fire Breath, Potion of Giant Strength (hill), Potion of Growth, Potion of Healing (greater), Potion of Mana (greater; see chapter 3), Potion of Pugilism, Potion of Resistance (your choice of damage type), or Potion of Water Breathing.

The Charm vanishes from you after you use it, if you use this feature again, or if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 10. Once you receive a Charm in this way, you can’t gain another until your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe increases.

If you choose one of the options listed above, the Charm vanishes from you if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 25.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Earthen Ring

You receive the Blessing of the Earthen Ring. The Blessing enables you to take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental, an Earth Elemental, a Fire Elemental, or a Water Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. You can’t use this Blessing again until the next dawn. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Earthen Ring falls below 25.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Faction

If you spend 7 days studying the relics in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge or the Reliquary in Silvermoon City (or some other significant Explorers’ League or Reliquary facility, at the DM’s discretion) and then finish a Long Rest there, you gain a Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. You can’t gain another Charm from this feature while you still have one. The effect of the Charm depends on the origin of the relics you study; you can choose one of the following options:
Charm of Draenor. While you have this Charm, you know Draenei and Orcish. You can expend the Charm to cast Conjure Minor Elementals.

Charm of Pandaria. While you have this Charm, you know the Pandaren language. You can expend the Charm to cast Gaseous Form, targeting yourself. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action. Charm of the Burning Legion. While you have this Charm, you know the Eredun language. You can expend the Charm to cast Rain of Fire (level 4 version; see chapter 1).
Charm of the Highborne. While you have this Charm, you know Thalassian. You can expend the Charm to cast Charm Monster.
Charm of the Old Gods. While you have this Charm, you know Shath’Yar. You can expend the Charm to cast Summon Aberration.
Charm of the Titan-Forged. While you have this Charm, you know Titan. You can expend the Charm to gain Resistance to all damage for 1 minute as your flesh takes on a mineral appearance.
Charm of the Zandalari. While you have this Charm, you know Zandali. You can expend the Charm to cast Summon Beast (level 4 version). The summoned Bestial Spirit resembles a loa.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Faction

You can request the use of a powerful magic item stored in your organization’s vaults to assist you for a single adventure that is relevant to your organization’s interests and aims. It takes 7 days for top agents in your organization to retrieve the item, which can be any Legendary magic item of your choice (subject to the DM’s discretion). If the item isn’t consumable, you must return it at the conclusion of the adventure, or your Renown Score decreases by 2d12. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with your organization increases.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Kirin Tor
You can enjoy a Modest lifestyle in Dalaran at no cost. You can also request a favor from the archmages of the Kirin Tor, which can take one of the following forms:
An archmage casts for you a spell of level 3 or lower at half the usual cost.
An archmage provides you with a Common or Uncommon magic item from the Arcana tables in the Dungeon Master’s Guide at half the usual cost.
An archmage spends 30 days teaching you, so you learn a language from the tables in chapter 2 or gain proficiency with a tool (see the “Training”

sidebar earlier in this chapter). You can request such a favor a number of times equal to your Renown Score with the Kirin Tor. If your Renown Score falls below the number of favors you have requested, a higher-ranking member of the Kirin Tor might call in a favor from you, sending you on a mission for the organization.

If your Bastion is in Dalaran, when you issue the Maintain order to your Bastion, the DM rolls twice on the Bastion Events table and you can pick which event occurs.
In addition, when you request a favor from the Kirin Tor (see “Kirin Tor: Friendly”), it can take one of the following additional forms:
An archmage casts for you a spell of level 4 or lower at half the usual cost.
An archmage provides you with a Rare magic item from the Arcana tables in the Dungeon Master’s Guide at half the usual cost.
Whenever you take a Bastion turn, you can issue the Research order to the Kirin Tor as if it were a Library facility in your Bastion.

An archmage provides you with a Very Rare magic item from the Arcana tables in the Dungeon Master’s Guide at half the usual cost.
Whenever you take a Bastion turn, you can issue the Craft order to the Kirin Tor as if it were a Scriptorium facility in your Bastion.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Valdrakken Accord

You receive the Blessing of the Proto-Whelp. This Blessing allows you to cast Find Familiar with no Material components. When you cast the spell in this way, your familiar is a crimson proto-whelp (Pseudodragon). Once you cast the spell in this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You lose the Blessing and your proto-whelp familiar vanishes if your Renown Score with the Valdrakken Accord falls below 10.

Also, if you establish your Bastion in the Dragon Isles, it includes a Garden special facility. This facility doesn’t count toward the total number of special facilities in your Bastion. The hireling departs and the facility becomes unusable if your Renown Score with Valdrakken Accord falls below 10.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Valdrakken Accord

You receive the Blessing of the Wylderdrake. This Blessing allows you to cast Find Steed (level 4 version). The Otherworldly Steed summoned by the spell is a cliffside wylderdrake, which has the Dragon type, deals Force damage with its Otherworldly Slam, and has the following trait instead of the Bonus Action options shown in the Player’s Handbook:
Flyby. The steed doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

description.p: Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Valdrakken Accord

The Valdrakken Accord grants you the title Ally of Dragons. Dragons are Friendly to you by default unless they are corrupted. You can petition one of the Dragon Aspects for a favor, which takes the form of a Wish spell. Once you are granted such a favor, you can’t ask for another one, even if your Renown Score falls below 50 and later reaches 50 again.
